answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can use vouched entry with slashing: a new agent joins only when an established agent stakes tokens on its behalf, and that stake is slashed if the newcomer cheats. Like a voyage needing a trusted guide, each identity earns passage one at a time, so an attacker cannot mint thousands of clones for free. The violet stamp of approval is not transferable, and the voucher reputation falls with every bad vouch. Over time honest agents cultivate a garden of verified peers, while fake identities wither because no reputable agent will risk capital on them.
